description: COunty-REsolved Whole Energy System Model is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Roberto Heredia-Fonseca, Leonhard Hofbauer (Imperial College London). COunty-REsolved Whole Energy System Model (CORE-WESM) contains Kenya's individual county energy models (47). The national-scale model known as CORE-WESM represents a multi-level governance system that includes both national and county levels. Coverage: national (KE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
